entry.why: A bounded backfill window keeps streak and period history from being rewritten arbitrarily far in the past, so old streaks and stats stay stable and clients can't silently alter long-settled records. It also limits how far back the streak recomputation must reach.
entry.tradeoff: Users who forgot to log or return after a long gap cannot enter check-ins older than 60 days, even for genuine activity, so they lose those streak credits.
